mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) indicates a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS is declining but the other is not, or when the joint decline does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 2% (INDPRO) signals a supply shock, leading to economic slowdown concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 2% monthly, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates economic expansion and corporate hiring, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 700,000 units) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a stable monetary environment, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails when either FEDFUNDS is low and CPIAUCSL is high, or when the joint signal does not produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 3%) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
